ideal: Every repo a Code Project attaches has shared rules, a short pull request template, an issue form and CI, so a fresh thread starts ready.

sources.title: Creating a pull request template for your repository

quality: No setup check fails: the rules file, its import, the main rule, the templates, CI and settings are all in place.
speed: One setup check reads its files within a second.
consumption: The pull request template stays under 150 words, since every thread reads it.
